title: Joe and Mac: Caveman Ninja - Level 1
description:
It's the BG from the 1st level of the game.
Not much has changed, except for two things.
The BG now uses palettes 3 and 5, instead of 3 and 7 and there's now a .palmask file.
Hobz's version had no such thing.
Have fun!
